repository.name: Documentation repository
repository.description: Your private GitHub repository in owner/repository format.

github_token.name: GitHub read token
github_token.description: A fine-grained token with read-only Actions access to the documentation repository. Enter it in this field.

mqtt_username.name: MQTT username
mqtt_username.description: Username for the MQTT broker account that receives documentation update notifications.

mqtt_password.name: MQTT password
mqtt_password.description: Password for that MQTT broker account.

mqtt_host.name: MQTT broker host
mqtt_host.description: Hostname or IPv4 address of a custom broker. Leave blank to use the local Mosquitto broker with the MQTT username and password.

mqtt_port.name: MQTT broker port
mqtt_port.description: Port for a custom broker. Defaults to 8883.

mqtt_tls.name: Use TLS for MQTT
mqtt_tls.description: Encrypt the connection to a custom broker with TLS. Enabled by default for custom brokers.

mqtt_topic.name: MQTT update topic
mqtt_topic.description: Topic for documentation update notifications. Defaults to piche/documentation/ready.
